# Copilot Instructions 

## General rules
- Ask clarifying questions when requirements are unclear.
- Keep changes small and reviewable.
- Prefer tests for non-trivial logic and API endpoints.
- Validate inputs at boundaries; handle errors consistently.
- Avoid adding new dependencies unless necessary and documented.
- Update SDLC artifacts when decisions change.

## Output preferences
- Provide Markdown ready to commit for docs.
- Provide code changes as diffs or full files if asked.
